milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate within view distance of the polished granite slab at spawn-relative (-5, 1, -5) and face toward it, modeling that the player can visually identify the target block. The slab is placed on a stone brick pedestal surrounded by oak fences. max_distance=16 allows detection from most positions in the 17x17 arena since the key verification is facing direction (the player has oriented toward and recognized the block). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is genuinely looking toward the slab, not just standing nearby while facing away.
